A '''sensor-stealth system''',<ref name="EGWT" /> also known as a '''sensor-stealth array''',<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Out Of Nowhere}}</ref> was used to hide energy signatures emanating from [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They worked to electronically muffle signatures generated from the craft's [[Engine/Legends|engines]], [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], or [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and hide them from [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.<ref name="CCG" />
